hard_failures: HF-06 (critical; nearest code, the A0 taxonomy has no internal-contradiction code): quantifiers.formal lines 54-55 read 'not exists q in I+ with gamma subset J^-(q) intersect M' and D5 lines 79-81 defines q by 'gamma([0,T)) is contained in the causal past J^-(q)'. That is whole-curve single-q containment, which contradicts the class's own canonical predicate at visibility.definition lines 219-220 (single-q TAIL: exists q AND t0 with gamma([t0,T)) contained in J^-(q)) and contradicts quantifiers.negation line 88, which negates the tail predicate. The expansion is strictly weaker: the schema's own example at line 220 (geodesic that starts in the exterior and ends inside the black-hole region) has a visible tail while the whole curve is not contained in any J^-(q), so it satisfies lines 54-55 but violates the canonical conclusion at line 251. quantifiers.formal and quantifiers.negation are therefore not exact negations of each other, and the class as formally expanded is not equivalent to the F0 AF-WCC-VAC-GEN conclusion object. The canonical gate returns PASS with failed_rules=[] at this hash because R03/R10 check domain resolution and field presence, never agreement with visibility.definition.

HF-06 (major; nearest code, dangling-symbol): conclusion.statement_formal line 251 uses AF_{I+}(M_D), which no leaf of the document defines (grep AF_{I+} matches line 251 only; i_plus.definition line 200 names the concept in prose, and quantifiers D3 line 74 gives the completion) and complete(I+_D), which is defined prose-only at i_plus.completeness_definition line 202. The class is declared bound to statement_formal at line 255, so its equivalence to the F0 text 'the MGHD admits a conformal completion with a complete future null infinity I+' is currently a reader's reconstruction, not a checkable identity.

findings.statement: Operative quantifier expansion contradicts the canonical visibility predicate (whole curve vs tail); quantifiers.formal is strictly weaker than the conclusion it is supposed to expand, and quantifiers.negation does not negate quantifiers.formal.

D0 is not well-typed. D0 mixes pair-indexed Sobolev regularities with the smooth-with-decay default, while the binder is (s,delta), G is indexed G_{s,delta}, and X^{s,delta}_vac is pair-indexed; the smooth branch has a Frechet ambient space and no (s,delta) values (line 150). The same leaf also says the class 'is fixed at these values', which conflicts with quantifying over all of D0. Two competent readers can instantiate the class differently (all admissible regularities vs one fixed regime), which is the artifact's own schema_falsifiers[0] at line 282 firing on the domain.

The class-contract binding does not resolve inside the authoritative artifact. class_contract_pointer line 38 targets artifacts/formulation/formulation_taxonomy.yaml#class_contracts.AF-WCC-VAC-GEN; the controller's canonical artifact research_map/formulation_taxonomy.yaml (276009f4) has no class_contracts key at all (top-level key is classes), and the two copies are not byte-identical (canonical 276009f4 vs authoring c8e979a1). f0_binding.class_contract_supplement line 311 also points at the authoring copy. This was recorded against an earlier revision in reviews/A1-rebind-coverage.json; it is re-measured here at the reviewed head and remains unresolved.

consistency_evidence is not hash-bound. artifacts/formulation/evidence/taxonomy_consistency.json records only paths, consistent=true, and an empty divergence list; it carries no sha256 of either compared artifact and no timestamp. Line 311 cites it as the consistency evidence for declared_f0_sha256 276009f4, but the evidence cannot establish which bytes were compared, so it does not satisfy the project rule that a result is an artifact plus evidence referenced by hash.

Header hygiene and timestamp. There are seven duplicate top-level revised_at keys (lines 8, 10, 12, 14, 16, 20, 23) and two revised_at_unused keys (lines 26, 28); YAML 1.2 forbids duplicate mapping keys, PyYAML silently keeps the last, and a strict parser errors. The effective revised_at and f0_binding.checked_at are 2026-09-12T00:30:00+08:00, about nine minutes ahead of wall clock at review time (00:21:13) and ahead of the file mtime; timestamp_provenance line 29 documents exactly this failure mode for authored_at, so the earlier correction did not generalise to the new keys.

Revision lineage is prose-only. revision is 11 (line 30) with supersedes: null (line 31), so no machine-readable predecessor hash exists; the only lineage is delta comments, and the rev10 comment (lines 21-22) names 565a6e50, which is the F0 rev3-prime canonical hash recorded at schemas/taxonomy_cases.jsonl:1 and reviews/A1-rebind-coverage.json, not a hash carried by any F1 revision field I read (rev10 field read 0fcc6a19 at 00:18, rev11 field 276009f4). A gate verdict citing a revision label rather than a sha256 cannot be audited against this header.

positives: P-1 Intended conclusion object matches the F0 rev4 AF-WCC-VAC-GEN contract on the load-bearing structure: forall admissible (s,delta), then exists comeager G_{s,delta}, then forall data, complete I+, no visible incomplete geodesic, no black-hole-formation or SCC content (F0 research_map/formulation_taxonomy.yaml classes.AF-WCC-VAC-GEN.conclusion.text at 276009f4 vs F1 lines 48-55, 219-222, 246-266). The defect is in the quantifier expansion (F-1), not in the F0-facing conclusion field.

P-2 No class leakage or conclusion inflation found: class_components lines 32-37 are the frozen AF/WCC/VAC/GEN vector with no regularity_token; anti_scope lines 288-296 disclaims the two SCC classes and the scalar-symmetric class; forbidden_strengthenings lines 256-261 forbid inextendibility; the single-q SET variant is registered with parent_class and the same strictly-stronger relation in F1 lines 231-244 and in research_map/formulation_taxonomy.yaml variants (F0 rev4). The canonical class-separation gate reports no findings and check_class_schema.py R12/R13 do not fire.

P-3 The falsifier is two-tier and correctly resists the single-datum error: tier 1 requires non-meagerness or membership in an instantiated G* (lines 270-276), tier 2 is labelled refutes_strengthening_only (lines 277-280), and the non-machine-checkable step is named explicitly (line 276).

P-4 Epistemic status and citations are disclosed rather than inflated: epistemic_status open_problem, promotion_rule forbids self-promotion (lines 39-40), provenance.citation_status unverified with unresolved_citations (lines 312-324), numeric Sobolev thresholds marked UNVERIFIED (lines 120-121), and known_status carries the non-transfer warning (lines 303-309).

assignment_answers.conclusion_equivalent_to_F0_class_object: Yes on intended reading and in conclusion.statement_formal; NO as a checkable identity at this revision. quantifiers.formal plus D5 carry a third, unregistered whole-curve reading that is strictly weaker than the F0 tail conclusion (F-1), and statement_formal uses an undefined symbol (second hard failure).
assignment_answers.quantifier_domain_D_gen_well_posed: NO at this revision. The comeager quantifier itself is explicit and correctly ordered before the data (lines 48-55, 83), and Baire non-vacuity is argued at line 150, but D0 mixes pair-indexed regularities with the smooth default while G and X are pair-indexed (F-2); the diffeomorphism-quotient gap is disclosed at lines 132 and 151, so well-posedness is conditional.
assignment_answers.visibility_curve_class_well_posed: YES for D4 and the predicate (lines 77, 219-222): future-directed causal, future-inextendible in M, finite affine length, tail formulation, and an explicit warning that the negation is not B-containment. NO for the quantifier block that consumes it (F-1).
assignment_answers.does_wording_depend_on_a_lexical_linter: YES, and the artifact says so. G-FORM's structural gate returns PASS with failed_rules=[] at this hash while the semantic contradiction F-1 survives, because R03 checks domain_id resolution and field presence and R10 checks field presence, not agreement with visibility.definition. The artifact itself records that a rephrased statement with no forbidden token can carry SCC content (line 285) and that a gate matching the literal words open dense would accept a strictly stronger class (line 160). Token-level PASS is necessary but not sufficient evidence of class binding.
